pool.text: Empress Elizabeth established a custom house on the Temernik River to control trade.
The Russian commercial and trading company was founded at the merchants settlement.
The settlement was officially renamed as Rostov-on-Don by authorities.
Coal and iron ore supported the establishment of an iron foundry here.
A railway connection linking the city with Kharkiv was completed successfully.
The regional government moved from Novocherkassk to the city of Rostov-on-Don.
The first automatic telephone exchange in Russia commenced operation in the city.
The Volga-Don Shipping Canal was constructed, making the city a port.
The first television program was broadcast from the newly completed centre.
The Tebodin engineering company opened its fourth office in Rostov-on-Don.
A monument dedicated to Anton Chekhov was erected in the city.
Flydubai Flight 981 crashed during a go-around at the airport.
Rostov-on-Don was selected to host several matches of the World Cup.
The Wagner Group declared a rebellion and took control of the city.
